title: GalyVverse Repo Creation Request
description: A request to create a new repository in the GalyVverse organization, seeded from a registered JSON template. Submitted via repository_dispatch (client_payload.request), workflow_dispatch inputs, or a JSON file committed under requests/.

name.description: Repository name. Strict pattern prevents URL/path injection.

template.description: Template id registered in hub.config.json under 'templates'.

topics.description: GitHub topics to apply. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; max 50 chars each.

source.description: Origin of the request, e.g. 'manus' or 'copilot'.

dryRun.description: When true, the automation only logs planned actions and performs no GitHub API calls. Example/request files with dryRun=true are skipped by the push-triggered workflow.
